fields.name: Display_Error_NoDistributionList_0
fields.fieldText:
Email Content Error


On the Visit Report record no Email Content is updated. Edit the record, mark the checkbox "Update Email Content" and save the record. The Email Subject and Email Body should be updated. If you like to change the Email Content, edit the record, edit the content but don't mark the checkbox "Update Email Content" so that your adjustments to the content are not overwritten.
